title: Another life! A life of grace and virtue and happiness! It was true. It was not a dream from which he would wake. The past was past
html_source: Overall this is a powerful depiction of the concept of transubstantiation, which is the idea that the Communion wafer isn’t just a metaphor for the body of Christ, but it really is in essence the body of Christ. At this moment, Stephen believes that this sacrament will save him from his past life. Later in Chapter Five Stephen draws again upon transubstantiation, this time as a metaphor for art.
